stories.title: Spot a Roman soldier in Chester on Tuesday and you could win free Chester Races tickets
stories.summary: A Roman soldier will be handing out free tickets to Chester Races in Chester city centre on Tuesday 26 May. The giveaway is part of the promotion for Chester Racecourse’s annual Roman Day fixture, which takes place on Saturday 30 May. stories.title: VegEd expands across north Wales with 50p-a-head cookery workshops
stories.summary: A  mum–of-two is expanding low-cost plant-based cookery workshops across North Wales as demand grows from struggling communities. Passionate foodie Lisa Hinze, co-founder of VegEd says her long-term ambition is to build a nationwide network of “Vegucators” and teach one million people to cook healthy meals on a budget. stories.title: Chester Bookbinders restores Bible commemorating former student
stories.summary: A Bible donated to the University of Chester 70 years ago has been restored by a Chester bookbinder. stories.title: Police warn Flintshire dog owners they may smash car windows to save pets in heat
stories.summary: North Wales Police’s south Flintshire team has warned dog owners they may smash car windows to release pets left inside as temperatures rise.
